[LTIM.1.1.1] A `Time` value is a fully-specified point in time:

```
(utc_ns: Int64, tz_offset_ns: Int64)
```

Two logical `Int64` nanosecond components. Authors see exactly this model;
ordering, equality and arithmetic operate on `utc_ns` alone. The offset is
always a whole number of seconds ([LTIM.3.2.2]); how a runtime stores it is
its own.
